# Kai's Run

> Kai's Run is a mobile canine conditioning service that brings a professional self-powered slatmill to your driveway in Destin, Fort Walton Beach, and Niceville FL. One dog at a time. Climate controlled. No drop-off required. Structured exercise for high-drive dogs.

## About

Founded by Travis in Destin FL. Inspired by his Rhodesian Ridgeback mix Kai — a high-drive dog whose energy couldn't be touched by walks alone. The slatmill is a self-powered treadmill: the dog sets their own pace, no motor, nothing forced. One session changed everything. Kai's Run was built to bring that to every high-drive dog on the Emerald Coast.

## What We Offer

- Intro Session: $35 (1 dog) / $55 (2 dogs) — fitness assessment, slatmill introduction, Run Profile card
- Performance Session: $65 (1 dog) / $85 (2 dogs) — full conditioning session
- 4-Session Bundle: $220 | 8-Session Bundle: $400
- Coastal Membership (bi-weekly): $120/month
- Emerald Membership (weekly): $220/month
- Founding Athlete Program: $200 for 5 sessions — limited to 20 dogs, never offered again

## Service Area

Destin FL, Fort Walton Beach FL, Niceville FL, Miramar Beach FL, Shalimar FL, Sandestin FL
Okaloosa County area. Mobile service — we come to your driveway.

## What Makes This Different

The slatmill is non-motorized. The dog drives the belt with their own gait.
No forced pace, no minimum speed. Dogs self-select effort, adjust stride naturally.
Sessions are private (one dog at a time), climate controlled (critical in Florida summers),
and delivered to your home — no drop-off, no daycare stress, no other dogs.
